Section 16 is a cohesive provision establishing an environmental council and setting membership, chair and vice-chair designation, quorum, term, expenses, and allowances.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Environmental council establishment and membership rules
proposedGroups.reason: The subsections together define how the environmental council is created, who may serve, officer designations, quorum, term, and compensation-related rules.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall how the environmental council is established and governed for membership, officers, quorum, terms, expenses, and allowances.

reason: Section 17 is a single duties provision for the environmental council, covering requested studies and reports, receipt of submissions, and Minister-approved studies, investigations, and reports.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Environmental council study, investigation, reporting, and submissions duties

evidenceText: with the approval of the Minister study, investigate and report

proposedGroups.reason: The provision lists the council's duties for Act-related matters, including duties triggered by requests, public submissions, and Minister-approved work.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the environmental council's duties to study, investigate, report, and receive submissions under section 17.

reason: Section 18 is a focused authority allowing the environmental council to establish its own procedural rules to carry out its duties.

evidenceText: To carry out its duties the council may establish its own rules of procedure

proposedGroups.reason: The provision contains one procedural authority for the council's own rules of procedure.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall that the environmental council may establish its own rules of procedure to carry out its duties.

reason: Section 19 is a short operative rule identifying the recipient of reports made under section 17.

evidenceText: The reports to be made under section 17 shall be made to the Minister

proposedGroups.reason: The target contains one report-recipient requirement for reports made under section 17.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall that reports made under section 17 must be made to the Minister.

reason: Section 20 is a single annual-report duty for the environmental council, listing the matters to be included in reports to the Minister.

proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall what the environmental council's annual reports to the Minister must cover.

reason: Section 21 is a single tabling duty requiring the Minister to lay the environmental council's annual report before the next ensuing session of the Legislature.
